title: 第1章 噩梦开端
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

公元2008年·亚美利加·十一月下旬

春木镇，一座看起来平平无奇的小镇。

叮铃铃————

镇上唯一一所高中的放学铃响起，有人会去参加课外活动，有的人会去结伴玩耍，而刚刚十七岁的李艾却只想好好休息一下。

因为他已经好几天没有睡个安稳的觉了。

他在卫生间用冷水洗了一把脸，混杂了一点消毒水味道的自来水让他精神了一些，随后望向镜中的自己。

李艾面部线条清晰，五官端正，鼻梁微挺，几缕沾了水的黑色发丝沾在额前，再结合他的小麦肤色，给人的感觉就是一个很直观的亚裔帅哥。

如果说只是长得俊朗还显得有些单薄，那他的身材就是撑起这张脸的重要因素。

身高一米八七，体重九十千克，锻炼得当，没有过大的肌肉，全是常年锻炼留下的清晰刻线。

在将水龙头拧紧后，亚裔少年转身离开卫生间，找到自己的个人物品柜，正当他准备用不久前刚买的诺基亚N95听音乐时，一道清脆的声音却喊住了他。

“李艾，晚上有安排吗？”

他回头看去，只见一个怀中抱着课本，留着金色卷发的女生正在对自己说话。

南希·汤普森，她是春木镇警长的女儿，在校内有不少朋友，她长得明媚大气，一双眼睛如蓝宝石般美丽，同时还有少女特有的青春气息。

“是需要我帮你辅导功课吗？还是你家有派对？”李艾转头看向南希，眼神里的疲惫却怎么也藏不住。

“我请你帮我复习一下这两天的课。”南希抬起同样略显疲惫的眼睛，苦恼道：

“我这几天都没休息好，上课一直犯困，东西都听不进去，你知道我还想考大学的。”

亚美利加虽说快乐教育遍地，但也不缺想要上进的人。

南希家庭观念保守，同时还是传统的罗马正教信徒，她的父母都希望她能去城市读大学，然后在纽约或者其他大城市找份体面的工作，所以她必须参加SAT考试，这样才能拿到前往大学的通行证。

耳濡目染下，南希也颇为上进，时常求助这位成绩表全A+的好学生。

“你也没休息好？”李艾对此感同身受，他的精神状态同样糟糕，只是他的学习能力比较好，学习进度不会出现明显的落后。

Page (1/3)

AD 2008·America·Late November

Chunmu Town is an ordinary-looking town.

Jingle bell————

The school bell rang at the only high school in the town. Some people would go to participate in extracurricular activities, and some would go to play together, but Li Ai, who had just turned seventeen, just wanted to take a good rest.

Because he hasn't had a good night's sleep for several days.

He washed his face with cold water in the bathroom. The tap water mixed with a little disinfectant smell made him feel more energetic, and then he looked at himself in the mirror.

Li Ai's facial lines are clear, his facial features are correct, his nose is slightly straight, and a few strands of water-stained black hair are stuck to his forehead. Combined with his wheatish complexion, he gives the impression that he is a very handsome Asian guy.

If he looks a bit thin despite his handsome appearance, then his figure is an important factor in supporting this face.

He is 1.87 meters tall and weighs 90 kilograms. He is well-trained and has no overly large muscles. They are all clear lines left by years of exercise.

After tightening the faucet, the Asian teenager turned around and left the bathroom and found his personal belongings cabinet. Just as he was about to listen to music on the Nokia N95 he had just bought not long ago, a crisp voice stopped him.

"Li Ai, do you have any plans for the evening?"

He looked back and saw a girl with blond curly hair holding a textbook in her arms talking to him.

Nancy Thompson is the daughter of the Sheriff of Springwood Town. She has many friends in school. She is bright and majestic, with eyes as beautiful as sapphires, and she also has the unique youthfulness of a girl.

"Do you need me to help you with your homework? Or is there a party at your house?" Li Ai turned to look at Nancy, but he couldn't hide the tiredness in his eyes.

"I ask you to help me review the lessons of the past two days." Nancy raised her eyes, which were also slightly tired, and said distressedly:

"I haven't had a good rest these past few days. I've been feeling sleepy in class and can't listen to anything. You know I still want to get into college."

Although America is full of happy education, there is no shortage of people who want to make progress.

Nancy's family is conservative and she is a traditional Roman Orthodox believer. Her parents hope that she can go to university in the city and then find a decent job in New York or other big cities, so she must take the SAT test in order to get a pass to university.

Under the influence of what she has heard and seen, Nancy is also quite motivated and often seeks help from this good student with all A+ grades.

"You haven't had a good rest either?" Li Ai felt the same way. His mental state was equally bad, but his learning ability was better and his learning progress would not lag significantly behind.
